Dive into color and pattern in this vibrant Tie & Dye Workshop. Learn how to transform plain fabric into eye-catching designs using classic resist-dyeing techniques. Explore different tying methods, folding styles, and color combinations to create unique patterns like spirals, stripes, and abstract blends. Guided step-by-step by a professional artist, this workshop is fun, hands-on, and beginner-friendly.

All materials are included, just come ready to experiment with colors, get a little messy, and take home your own custom tie-dyed creation.

Perfect for beginners, DIY enthusiasts, and anyone looking for a playful and creative experience.

Discover the magic of color in this immersive Watercolor Blending Workshop. Learn how to seamlessly blend colors to create soft gradients, smooth transitions, and expressive effects using watercolor techniques. Explore methods like wet-on-wet, layering, and color mixing to bring depth and harmony to your artwork. Guided step-by-step by a professional artist, this workshop is soothing, experimental, and perfect for beginners.

All materials are included, just come ready to play with colors, explore fluid techniques, and create your own beautifully blended compositions.

Perfect for beginners, art lovers, and anyone looking to unwind through a calming and creative painting experience.

Experience focus and creativity in this calming Guided Mandala Drawing Workshop. Learn how to create intricate mandala patterns using structured, step-by-step techniques that build symmetry, balance, and flow. Explore elements like repetitive patterns, line work, and detailing while developing patience and mindfulness through the process. Guided by a professional artist, this workshop is designed to be relaxing, meditative, and beginner-friendly.

All materials are included, just come ready to slow down, draw, and immerse yourself in the rhythm of patterns. Take home your own beautifully detailed mandala artwork along with a sense of calm and accomplishment.

Perfect for beginners, art enthusiasts, and anyone looking for a mindful and therapeutic creative experience.

Explore the power of simplicity in this engaging Minimalist Line Art Workshop with Sketch Pens. Learn how to create striking, detailed illustrations using clean line work and just two colors of sketch pens. This workshop focuses on composition, balance, contrast, and storytelling through minimal elements—helping you turn simple lines into expressive, visually appealing artwork. Guided step-by-step by a professional artist, the process is intuitive, creative, and beginner-friendly.

All materials are included, just bring your creativity and an eye for detail. Walk away with your own bold, minimal artwork created using a limited color palette.

Perfect for beginners, design enthusiasts, and anyone looking to explore modern, minimal art styles.

Capture the serenity of nature in this immersive Watercolor Landscape Workshop. Learn how to paint beautiful landscapes using fluid watercolor techniques that bring depth, light, and atmosphere to your work. Explore essentials like color blending, washes, layering, and creating textures for skies, mountains, trees, and water bodies. Guided step-by-step by a professional artist, this workshop is designed to be calming, expressive, and beginner-friendly.

All materials are included, just come ready to explore, paint, and express your creativity through soft, flowing landscapes. Perfect for beginners, art lovers, and anyone looking for a peaceful and inspiring creative experience.

Discover the beauty of nature through texture and printmaking in our Biophiliic Print Workshop. Learn how to transform simple leaves into stunning textured artworks using creative layering and printing techniques. This hands-on session is guided step-by-step by a professional artist and is perfect for beginners as well as art enthusiasts.

All materials are included, just bring your curiosity and creativity. Walk away with your own textured leaf artwork and a calming, nature-inspired experience.

Explore the beauty of textures and florals in this hands-on Texture Flowers Print Workshop. Learn how to create stunning flower prints using textured techniques that add depth, movement, and character to your artwork. Guided step-by-step by a professional artist, this workshop is beginner-friendly and deeply relaxing.



All materials are included, just come ready to experiment, create, and take home your own textured floral artwork.



Perfect for beginners, and anyone looking for a creative break

Thanks in advance.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi MD,
Thank you for your interest in the FX School's Visual Effects course!

The FX School Scholarship usually takes place towards the end of the Calendar year, typically early- to mid-December.

All subjects are not always open for Scholarships. At the time of announcement, the subjects eligible for Scholarships will also be announced.

If you are keen on joining sooner, we do not recommend waiting for the Scholarship. We understand that many students face financial constraints and offer Quarterly and Monthly payment schemes as options to help facilitate past this barrier.

Please call 022 4235 4235 and Schedule Your [Free] Counselling Session to learn more about the courses of interest as well as the exact payment options and amounts for your specific interests.

We look forward to speaking with you and, hopefully, welcoming you as an FX School student soon... Good luck!

name: Shweta Art and Craft
description: Shweta Rane Art Classes offers engaging drawing and craft sessions that nurture creativity and artistic confidence in children. I’m Shweta Rane, a Visual Art and Atelier teacher at Kanakia International School, Chembur, with over 6 years of experience teaching IB and CBSE curricula. I have completed the Introductory Cambridge Primary Art & Design course, strengthening my approach to creative education. featured_reviews.name: Surbhi Dugar
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is the place where THE BARRY JOHN Sir personally teaches and is present throughout the sessions, working closely with students every single day. A true mentor in every sense, learning from someone of his calibre gives you a foundation so strong that you won’t feel the need to look elsewhere. He is THE MENTOR of all mentors in this craft.

What really stands out is how thoughtfully the course is designed. You may walk in as a complete beginner, but step by step, you are pushed, guided and shaped into a much more confident and aware actor, gradually reaching an advanced level by the end. You come out as a trained, working actor with a clear understanding of what it takes to be on a set and what is expected of you. The training is intensive and demands discipline, consistency and emotional honesty, but that is exactly what makes the process so rewarding.

Beyond acting techniques, you also gain a deeper understanding of yourself, your body, your voice, and your emotional range. The environment is safe, encouraging, and deeply collaborative, allowing you to take risks and truly grow. If you are serious about acting and willing to put in the work, this is not just a class, it’s a transformative experience that stays with you long after it ends.

Grateful to Barry John Sir, it was truly an honour to learn from a legendary teacher like him. It felt like living a dream I never imagined would come true. I am deeply thankful for the space he has built and for the passion he brings to teaching this craft. There is truly no one better than Barry John himself to learn from. It’s no surprise that so many of the finest actors in our country have been his students.

featured_reviews.name: ankit chandolia
featured_reviews.review_text:
When it comes to acting then Barry Sir jesa koi nahi.. A man who is passionate about his work and a very disciplined person you’ll ever come across.
Special thanks to Bhavish bhai & Debu bhai for their support, guidance and valuable feedbacks and Pallavi for her caring nature and Gajju bhaiya k hath ka bana hua khana bhot miss karenge.

featured_reviews.name: Mikhaila Shenoy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Joining this course was one of the best decisions I’ve made for improving my acting skills. It began at a very basic level and gradually proceeded in complexity, making it suitable for actors across all stages. We were also given homework almost every weekend, which helped me stay in touch with whatever we learned in class and also build upon those learnings creatively. Barry Sir is also a firm believer in “less thinking, more doing”, which is what I found very unique about this course. We rarely spoke about any acting theory, instead we were constantly made to do exercises and activities for our movement (body language, posture, walking), speech (tone, pitch, volume, rhythm), imagination and emotional involvement and intensity. Sir would then give us his feedback (which is brutally honest; no sugarcoating) on how to improve and progress in that particular skillset. I personally loved this as it gave me insights into my own patterns and also taught me how to break them; very useful for effective character building. All activities also ensured we learned how to work by ourselves (monologues/ soliloquies) and also with another person/ in a group (typical in dialogues and scenework). Lastly, I’m going
to miss Sir’s sense of humour, there was not a single class where I did NOT laugh; he is effortlessly hilarious!
I truly feel like a FREE BIRD :)

featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello.
Myself Savita Sharma.
I joined weekend course under Barry John sir to get corrections in my acting skills.
And i am very glad to share that i got the same in every class & in every week projects.
Barry John sir is a man of 'work' & so does he expect from his students to 'keep working with full honesty and dedication'.
Thank you 'Free Bird Collective' for adding one beautiful feather in my acting career."

featured_reviews.name: Shaynan Vinayak
featured_reviews.review_text: The best 3 months of my life! This course completely changed my perspective on acting. We didn’t just learn techniques — Barry sir constantly pushed us to go deeper, to connect with our characters using our entire body and emotions. The experience was challenging, inspiring, and transformative. Highly recommend this school to anyone serious about discovering their true potential as an actor.

featured_reviews.name: Vikrant Rathore
featured_reviews.review_text: Before joining the course i had this confusion whether i have chose the right place and not frauds roaming in the market. This is the real barry john u can choose to learn acting. What a sessions i have attended. The best thing i can recall is preparing the monologues which were too lengthy and were easily done with Barry Sir's guidance. How to bring out your fear and hesitation you will learn hear only and the one to one feedbacks provided by him...thank you Sir it was a honour witnessing the legend. "Barry John"

featured_reviews.name: Abhimanyu Kukreja
featured_reviews.review_text: Barry John - A Fantastic teacher and a learned man!! His faculty members Debu and Bhavish really pushed us to deliver results. The course started with remembering our memories and slowly but steadily went into, how a human would react to a certain situation....! What I learned from Barry sir was to first be an emphatic and aware human, that will automatically transform into the actor one becomes...! It's hard to write down an entire 3 months of experience at the school, because the course had many aspects. But to understand Barry sir's style of teaching, and to be a better human, even before one becomes an actor, do join this course and experience it first hand yourself! :)  Every single student in our course is a better actor today than what we were during the beginning of the course!

featured_reviews.name: Rit Prasanna
featured_reviews.review_text:
Barry sir's dedication, even at his age, is nothing short of inspiring. He pushed us to step out of our comfort zones and aim for excellence in our craft. His welcoming nature made learning a breeze.

In our final session, when he said, "Treat this school as your second home, keep coming back," it truly touched my heart.

I lost track of time, craving more classes, and wishing this journey would never conclude. I yearned to absorb more wisdom from Barry sir and other fellow students.

I'm also immensely grateful to Akshat, Debu, Pallavi, and Gajju bhai, who were incredibly accommodating and made the entire experience seamless. This acting school experience was something special.

featured_reviews.review_text:
As a chef and hospitality trainer, I’ve used many venues for hands‑on classes and pop‑ups — The Workshop Hall is one of the best. The space is impeccably clean, thoughtfully laid out, and sized perfectly for intimate gatherings and interactive sessions. Lighting is bright but warm, acoustics are excellent for demonstrations, and the workstations are ergonomic and well equipped, making it easy for participants to focus and follow along.

The management is responsive and professional, helping with setup and tech needs so I can concentrate on teaching.
